svg.title: Aligned deletion evidence
svg.desc: Five deletions aligned to six equally spaced gene positions. Del 1 removes genes 1-3; Del 2, 2-3; Del 3, 2-4; Del 4, 3-5; Del 5, 4-6. Gray bodies show retained DNA; thin magenta bars mark missing DNA. Rows share reference coordinates so deletion widths remain visible. Positions are schematic, not genetic distances.
svg.text: Gray rods = retained DNA; magenta = deleted interval
